wins.label: Record AUM and consecutive net inflows
wins.evidence: assets under supervision reached another record this quarter, surpassing $3 trillion and representing our 27th consecutive quarter of long-term net inflows

wins.label: Strong durable revenue growth in AWM
wins.evidence: management other fees and private banking and lending revenues, which together were a record $3.4 billion this quarter and up 9% versus last year

wins.label: Robust alternatives fundraising
wins.evidence: We raised over $50 billion year-to-date and now expect 2024 fundraising to exceed $60 billion

wins.label: Market leadership in investment banking
wins.evidence: We remain #1 in the league tables for announced and completed M&A for the year-to-date

wins.label: Record FICC financing revenues
wins.evidence: record FICC financing revenues of $949 million, which rose 30% year-over-year

risks.label: Regulatory uncertainty on capital requirements
risks.evidence: There remains a lack of transparency and appreciation for the interconnectedness of capital requirements across the proposed fundamental review of the trading book, CCAR and the GSIP buffer

risks.label: M&A volumes still below historical averages
risks.evidence: M&A volumes year-to-date are 13% below 10-year averages

risks.label: Consumer platform drag on returns
risks.evidence: our results were impacted by selected items, including the narrowing of our consumer footprint which reduced our ROE by 80 basis points

risks.label: Ongoing losses in Apple Card platform
risks.evidence: something on the order of negative $50 million or $60 million per quarter
